purpose: Prepare G10 external-author empirical rerun; not a gate approval or model-equivalence claim
priority_reason: Only located small empirical qbl case with both author-packaged input and author-written exact call at fixed source commit

bibliographic_target.work: Ferrari, McAlister, Mebane and Wu (2019), Introduction to eforensics vignette
bibliographic_target.section: Washington, D.C. 2010 Mayoral Election Data Example / Using the eforensics function
bibliographic_target.limitation: Rmd interpolates computed values; no static rendered output or author fit found at the fixed commit

columns.NValid: integer valid votes cast as encoded by authors
columns.Votes: integer Vincent C. Gray votes W
columns.a: integer NVoters minus NValid, abstention A

formula_mapping_verified.interface: eforensics formula1 maps to observed winner votes w and formula2 maps to observed abstention a
formula_mapping_verified.caution: Do not reorder authors' formula call; compare another wrapper by observed-variable role, not argument position

model.g2_dependency: Mathematical target and estimands remain subject to G2 decision; Stan historical approximation is not presumed equivalent

documented_author_command: set.seed(48109); data(dc2010); mcmc <- list(burn.in=5000,n.adapt=1000,n.iter=1000,n.chains=1); samples_dc <- eforensics(Votes ~ 1,a ~ 1,data=dc2010,model='qbl',mcmc=mcmc,max.auto=10,eligible.voters='NVoters'); results_dc <- summary(samples_dc); print(results_dc)
command_status: Transcribed from vignette; not run in discovery; requires correct fixed-version package and JAGS environment

found_outputs.evidence: vignette eforensics_demonstration and inline results text
vignette chunks; plots not frozen in source tarball

structural: same qbl source/priors/likelihood and wrapper settings
same monitored parameter names and output schema
all posterior probabilities in [0,1] and pi[1]+pi[2]+pi[3] near 1 within numeric precision
proposed_comparison_before_new_execution.numeric: BLOCKED: no immutable numeric D.C. output found in bounded search of fixed commit, rdrr.io docs, likely GitHub Pages/r-universe HTML, or author-site tutorial. A successful vignette run cannot approve G10 or be labeled external quantitative replication.

monte_carlo_proposal_not_frozen.separate_diagnostic_run: at least 4 independently initialized chains, distinct from literal one-chain author replay
monte_carlo_proposal_not_frozen.failure_policy: nonconvergence or unresolved multimodality => inconclusive; never retune after seeing target comparison
must_freeze_before_run: between-run tolerance based on both runs' MCSE
treatment of divergent modes and missing author MCSE

proposed_comparison_before_new_execution.external_numeric_fallback: Bolivia 2019 p.29 Chain 1 pi[1] Mean 0.9924773465, HPD 95% [0.991301,0.993592] only after same clean CSV is found or independently reconstructed and audited; large computation and model/chain differences require predeclared tolerance
proposed_comparison_before_new_execution.freeze_owner: G10 coordinator plus independent QA after G2 target decision

interpretation_limits: no fraud claim from D.C. demonstration
